determinism: integer-bigint engine, no floats, no RNG

scenarios.name: S1 · single default
scenarios.description: One desk fails to repay at the desk cap ($1.5M). Collateral seized at standard coverage; LoC honored at the 25% haircut.

scenarios.name: S2 · correlated defaults (systemic cap saturated)
scenarios.description: Four desks default simultaneously, totalling the 60% system cap ($6M). The stress the systemic cap is designed against.

scenarios.name: S3 · correlated defaults + reserve shortfall
scenarios.description: Couples the S2 correlated cascade with a pre-existing reserve drawdown (DIF at $0) to show the direct jump to junior capital.

scenarios.name: S4 · LoC delay / failure
scenarios.description: The committed LoC does not honor the draw within settlement (delay or refusal), so L2 contributes $0 and the loss cascades to reserves + tranches.

scenarios.name: S5 · 90% liquidity shock
scenarios.description: Collateral value collapses ~90% at liquidation time, so L1 recovery drops to ~10% of the desk cap; LoC still honored.

scenarios.name: S6 · non-Jito slot dominance
scenarios.description: Jito eligibility collapses to 0% on the leader schedule; no single-slot bundle lands, so gross revenue and the DIF build halt.
scenarios.measuredNote: Revenue line rerun with L_jito=0% ⇒ gross 0¢/yr; DIF contribution $0 for the period.

scenarios.name: S7 · congestion
scenarios.description: Network congestion backs the bundle past the debt window + grace, voiding the LoC draw; L2 contributes nothing this cycle.

scenarios.name: S8 · stale oracle data
scenarios.description: A stale price paints the desk solvent; by the time liquidation executes the position is deeper underwater, shrinking L1 recovery to ~5%.

scenarios.name: S9 · duplicate draw requests
scenarios.description: Two identical pulls land in the same slot. The atomic balance-state constraint should revert the second; modeled here as the vault being unchanged (all layers zero).
scenarios.measuredNote: Relies on cl_repay_and_settle’s atomic balance-state constraint; needs a devnet atomicity test to become testnet-observed.

scenarios.name: S10 · delayed settlement
scenarios.description: Settlement slips past the 24h debt window and 2h grace (e.g. RPC outage); the facility freezes mid-flight with one desk fully exposed and the LoC void.
scenarios.measuredNote: Window/grace constants are on-chain (24h / 2h); event-path evidence pending.

scenarios.name: S11 · infrastructure outage
scenarios.description: Geyser + RPC + bundle engine unreachable; no settlement, revenue build halts, and the DIF cannot be replenished. Flags the frozen pipeline, not a loss event.
scenarios.measuredNote: Depends on the Geyser latency probe (see investor v0 VALIDATION section).
